## Static Labs

These browser-based labs run directly from the course site and do not require a dynamic lab login. Use the module and lesson labels to match each lab to the slide deck where it is introduced.

### Cryptography Primitives

**01-CP Cryptography Introduction**

* [Cryptographic Primitives Overview](/assets/labs/asym_sym_overview/crypto_primitives.html)

**02-CP Hashing and Merkle Trees**

* [Interactive Hash Microlab](/assets/labs/micro-hashing/)
* [Merkle Tree Microlab](/assets/labs/merkle-trees/)
* [Hashing and Merkle Proofs Lab](/assets/labs/hashing_merkle/hashing_merkle_lab.html)

**03-CP Symmetric Encryption**

* [One-Time Pad XOR Microlab](/assets/labs/micro-xor/)
* [Pseudorandom Generator Microlab](/assets/labs/micro-prg/)
* [Symmetric Encryption Microlab](/assets/labs/symmetric_encryption/symmetric_encryption_lab.html)

**04-CP Asymmetric Encryption and Digital Signatures**

* [Digital Signatures and Asymmetric Encryption Lab](/assets/labs/signatures/)

### Distributed Systems Fundamentals

**01-DS Distributed Systems**

* [Centralized and Peer-to-Peer Network Lab](/assets/labs/distributed%20systems/distributed_systems_lab.html)

**02-DS Peer-to-Peer Design**

* [Peer-to-Peer Routing Lab: Flooding and DHTs](/assets/labs/p2p-routing/p2p_routing_lab.html)

**03-DS Trust and Peer-to-Peer Systems**

* [Peer-to-Peer Trust Simulation](/assets/labs/trust-simulation/trust_simulation_lab.html)

**04-DS Distributed Ledgers**

* [Tamper-Evident Ledger Lab](/assets/labs/tamper-ledger/tamper_ledger_lab.html)
